    Inspection scope
    Paint, place, undo, save named designs, and playtest validated maps. Browser saves use a separate 3D editor database. Edit reusable blocks, save or capture them to the library, assign connections, and assemble or generate full maps.
    Floors, scenery and character models are derived from the blueprint. Hidden roofs and boundaries do not intercept inspection.
